question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

All branded shoes are priced __extravagantly__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Expensively**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Extravagantly **means in a way that causes you to spend too much money. (एक तरह से जिसके कारण आपको बहुत अधिक पैसा खर्च करना पड़ता है)

 
 
• Example -* It is an extravagantly priced car.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Expensively **means in a way that costs a lot of money. (एक तरह से जिसमें बहुत पैसा खर्च होता है)
 
 
• Example -* There are other restaurants where you can eat less expensively.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Extravagantly**' and '**Expensively**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Modestly **means not talking much about self abilities or achievements. (अपनी क्षमताओं या उपलब्धियों के बारे में ज्यादा बात नहीं करना)
 
• **Economically **means in a way that involves careful use of money or resources. (एक तरह से जिसमें धन या संसाधनों का सावधानीपूर्वक उपयोग शामिल है)
 
• **Meagerly** means lacking desirable qualities such as richness or strength. (समृद्धि या ताकत जैसे वांछनीय गुणों की कमी)
